items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Max Keminsky, the trumpet man, whom I knew way back when I was working in the U.S.A. and whom I had not seen for years

ctx.x: I did this festival with the rhythm section of a very good French group called "The Swingers", whom I had worked with quite a number of times. Earl Hines, Memphis Slim, the blues singer and pianist, also Max Keminsky, the trumpet man, whom I knew way back when I was working in the U.S.A. and whom I had not seen for years, were also on the programme that night.

The next day I moved on to Modena for a concert with an amateur orchestra from Genoa. We had a very nice rehearsal, but everybody was worried because the clarinetist had forgotten his instrument in Genoa, and people were running all over Modena trying to find a clarinet for him. The concert was given in the most famous square in town, just behind the cathedral. Someone found an instrument for the clarinetist, and the concert was a great success. There seemed to be people there from the age of 7 years old to 90…
